Read from the public Posts tab of Nexus 193080 at the orchestrator session's request (21 comments;
3.0.0; 11 endorsements, 146 unique downloads, 1,572 views when read). Nothing was posted or replied
to. Times are as the page showed them, logged out.

## The comment: ignore, no reply

IAMTOKKO, 28 Sep 2026, 6:32AM, a reply in their own modifier-key thread. They ask again for modifier
keys, now saying they play on a controller with keyboard keys mapped onto its buttons.

**Decision (the user, 2026-09-28): ignore, no reply.** Modifier and arrow keys were already rejected
on 2026-09-27 (`docs/007-control-panel.md`, "Rejected"), and the user does not answer repeats of a
request that was already declined.
